requests.reply: {"translations": ["Seoyun, are you still at the company?", "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting isn't over. Jiwoo, did you leave work?", "I just left. But did the contract finish well?"]}
{"translations": ["Yeah, I stamped it yesterday. It's finally over now.", "Wow, only three days left.", "I know ㅠㅠ There's so much to do."]}

{"translations": ["Did you call a packing moving service?", "No haha, semi-packing. I'm moving on Saturday, so I have to pack the stuff myself.", "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day"]}

{"translations": ["I leave Barley at the pet hotel on Saturdays. They asked for an English name on the reservation form, so I wrote Barley haha", "ㅋㅋㅋㅋ I always get confused whether Barley is male or female", "She's female. She's three years old but is still shy"]}

{"translations": ["After moving, let's rest on Sunday. I miss Bori too haha. Want to grab brunch?", "Okay! Hyejin unnie is coming to help with the cleanup on Sunday.", "Oh, that's good. So Bori will be home that day too?"]}
{"translations": ["Yeah, oppa said he'll take me on Sunday morning.", "That's a relief. Should I call Subin too? ◆", "I asked, but Subin can't come on Sunday. She said she has a prior engagement."]}

{"translations": ["Too bad. Ah, what should I write for Chaeyul's English name? I need to send a calendar invite.", "He said to use Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' haha.", "Okay. What about the sofa? Bori always slept there."]}

{"translations": ["I put it on Carrot and got contacted right away. We decided to meet in person tomorrow evening.", "Wow, that's fast. Seoyun, you really cherished that sofa.", "Right ㅠㅠ But my new house is small, so I had no choice."]}

{"translations": ["Did you get the deposit for the old house? The landlady was quite strict.", "Not yet ㅠㅠ She told me to clean properly, so I have to wipe everything before Sunday.", "Wow, Sunday is a day off. Let's have Chae-yul do it haha"]}

{"translations": ["I know. They said they'll deposit the deposit right after the inspection.", "My older brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for his know-how?", "Oh really? Do you still do it?"]}

{"translations": ["No, I quit last year and now I run a cafe. But I'll still give you tips.", "Thanks haha, Jiwoo. Did you send the Monday meeting invitation to Chaeyul too?", "Yes, I just sent it. By the way, is it okay for Bori to take a car?"]}
{"translations": ["He runs away as soon as he sees a carrier lol. I'll lure him with snacks."]}
